blocks.text: Money follows Principles, not opinions.

LAW 1
Effort Conversion
Money is stored human effort, time, and skill.
🧪 Lab: The Price of Life
Cost: 22 Hours of life.

LAW 2
Finite Income
Why: Income is limited; desires are not.

LAW 3
Cash Flow Supremacy
Cash flow matters more than total income.

LAW 4
Emotional Dominance
Money decisions are emotional first, logical later.

LAW 5
Social Comparison
We measure success relative to others.

LAW 6
Scarcity Memory
Past pain shapes future behavior.

LAW 7
Survival First
Protection precedes growth.

LAW 8
Goal-Based Money
Money without purpose gets wasted.

LAW 9
Inflation Reality
If growth < inflation, you are getting poorer.

LAW 10
Ownership
Buying stock = Owning a business.

LAW 11
Risk-Reward Balance
Higher return ALWAYS demands higher risk.

LAW 12
Market Cycles
Markets move in cycles, not straight lines.

LAW 13
Valuation Gravity
Price always returns to value eventually.

LAW 14
Leverage Destruction
Leverage kills faster than intelligence saves.

LAW 15
Probability
Markets reward probability, not prediction.
Behavioural Supremacy
Your behaviour matters more than your knowledge. A disciplined fool beats an impulsive genius.

RULE 1
The 100 - Age Rule
Equity % = 100 - Your Age.
Equity: 70%
Debt: 30%

RULE 2
Core-Satellite
80% Boring (Core) + 20% Risky (Satellite).

RULE 3
One Goal = One Bucket
Never mix retirement money with wedding funds.

RULE 4
Rule of 72
Years to Double = 72 ÷ Interest Rate.
Doubles in: 18 Years
📈 Full Compounding Visualizer — year-by-year, not just the doubling point →

RULE 5
Time in Market
Time in market > Timing the market.
⏱️ Time Value of Money Calculator — put a number on the wait →

RULE 6
Early Years Multiplier
Money invested early works 10x harder.

RULE 7
Emergency Fund
6-12 Months expenses in Liquid Cash.

RULE 8
Insurance First
Health & Term Insurance BEFORE investing.

RULE 9
Single Asset Rule
Never let one asset be >50% of net worth.

RULE 10
Position Sizing
Max 5-10% capital in one idea.

RULE 11
5-Year Rule
Can't hold for 5 years? Don't buy.

RULE 12
Downside First
Ask "What can I lose?" before "What can I make?".

RULE 13
Lifestyle Ceiling
Fix lifestyle cost even as income grows.

RULE 14
One Bad Year
Assume one financial disaster per decade.

RULE 15
Sleep Test
If portfolio disturbs sleep, it's too risky.

RULE 16
Human Capital
Skills > Assets (Early Life).

RULE 17
Diversification
Never rely on a single salary source.

RULE 18
Skill > Saving
Spending on upskilling > Saving in FD (in 20s).

RULE 19
Debt Limit
Total EMI < 30% of Income.

RULE 20
Asset Borrowing
Borrow only for assets that appreciate.

RULE 21
Full Payment
Can't pay full bill? Can't afford it.

RULE 22
Rebalancing
Reset asset allocation once a year.

RULE 23
Fewer Decisions
Automation (SIP) > Active decisions.

RULE 24
Know What You Own
Don't buy what you can't explain.

RULE 25
Not a Salary
Markets do not owe you monthly income.

RULE 26
No Prediction
No one predicts consistently. Stick to systems.

RULE 27
Losing is Normal
Small losses are the cost of doing business.

RULE 28
Health > Wealth
No plan survives poor health.

RULE 29
Longevity
Plan for 30 years of retirement, not 10.

RULE 30
Simplicity
Simple plans outperform complex ones.
Self-Awareness
The best financial strategy is the one you can actually stick to.

summary: Immutable laws of money — compounding, leverage, time value explained simply.
title: The Constitution
